# Plexory

> A native macOS desktop browser for Claude Code. Discover, compare, and manage MCP servers, skills, slash commands, and hooks in one app.

Plexory scans your local Claude Code config (`~/.claude.json`, `~/.claude/`, and per-project `.claude/` folders), browses the public marketplace, and shows a side-by-side diff so stale tools and popular-but-missing ones surface in one view.

- Platform: macOS
- Stack: Tauri 2, React 19, Rust
- Price: Free tier (scanner, browse, manual install); Pro $29 one-time or $5/mo unlocks one-click install, auto-update, backup
- Homepage: https://koleeit.github.io/plexory-releases/
- Download: https://github.com/koleeit/plexory-releases/releases/latest

## Features

- Local scanner: indexes settings, MCP servers, hooks, and slash commands across global and per-project config.
- Marketplace browser: searches GitHub topics and Anthropic's official list for available MCP servers and tools.
- Diff view: compares installed tools against the marketplace to flag outdated or missing entries.
